maintenanceAssessment: AND.40 unit 5 successor r3 of and-40-u5-r2, after the first hosted run at 8b49cee. It changes only .github/workflows/ci.yml (the maui job installs the pinned MAUI workload set 10.0.401 with dotnet workload install android maui-android --version 10.0.401 on SDK 10.0.400, and fails closed unless dotnet workload list reports Workload version 10.0.401 and the android 36.1.69 and maui-android 10.0.20 manifests; AND.40 decision 22) and .github/workflows/security.yml (the codeql-csharp job installs the same workload set for its locked restore, drops its setup-python step, and builds the net10.0 target with -f; decision 22). No dependency version, lockfile, Gradle or Android closure input changes: versions and the android-licences evidence are the r2 values. The workload set is recorded in eng/policy/dotnet-toolchain.json (workloadSet); no workload closure is vendored in this repository.
